title: Hollow Knight Nails
description: Rename Swords to Nails to turn them into The Nail from Hollow Knight!
body:
**Rename Swords to Nails to turn them into The Nail from Hollow Knight!**

How to Use:
Rename Sword to Nail in an anvil like so,
Wooden Sword > Wooden Nail
Stone Sword > Stone Nail
Copper Sword > Copper Nail
Golden Sword > Golden Nail
Iron Sword > Iron Nail
Diamond Sword > Diamond Nail
Netherite Sword > Netherite Nail
